svg.title: How two photons change output probabilities

cc:Work.dc:title: How two photons change output probabilities
cc:Work.dc:description: Original exact ideal two-photon beam-splitter calculation. Distinguishable probabilities (1/4,1/2,1/4); indistinguishable probabilities (1/2,0,1/2). Lossless balanced splitter, one photon per distinct spatial input; ideal indistinguishable photons have matching wave packets/polarization and arrive simultaneously. Not a computational-advantage benchmark.

cc:Agent.dc:title: AI Tech Review; original deterministic figure
